company.description:
Does this sound familiar?

* You start your day with 100+ unread emails.
* Your socials haven’t been touched in weeks.
* That blog post is still just a headline.
* Everything keeps getting pushed to “next week.”

=> You’re wearing too many hats: CEO, marketer, salesperson, accountant, and customer service all in one...

Meet Marblism: Your AI Employee Dream Team.

Virtual assistants who handle the busywork, so you can focus on growth.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 85 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 70 (-9).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
